genomic_intelligence.decision: Not a suitable primary human EN-TEx enhancer baseline. No model predictions were substituted for experimental labels. Prior human chromatin/expression catalog remains separately recorded.

sequence_viewer.provenance: Previously verified GRCh38 graph reference windows for first-encountered complex-trait and Mendelian examples, selected independently of labels and scores.
sequence_viewer.acknowledged_action: Selected the complex-traits example's central variant base at 1-based record position 101.
sequence_viewer.interpretation: Reference sequence inspection, not model performance or an allele-specific graph representation.

ngs_workbench.interpretation: Evidence-based review of native repository outputs; no synthetic Workbench lifecycle records were created.
